requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Cause number, if one was assigned
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Cause number, if one was assigned
requiredBeforeFiling.why: no case identifier is held for a record the platform has not seen
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the cause number if one was assigned, copied from your papers - if none was assigned, write none, because that decides the MC case-type question the petition branch turns on

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: County where the infraction was handled
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: County where the infraction was handled
requiredBeforeFiling.why: no case fact is held for a record the platform has not seen
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the Indiana county where the infraction was handled, from your own papers

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Was prosecution deferred, answered from your own papers
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Was prosecution deferred, answered from your own papers
requiredBeforeFiling.why: the deferral answer routes between the automatic rule and the five-year branch, and only the participant's papers hold it
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: whether prosecution was deferred - the automatic rule does not apply where it was, and the five-year branch does

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Answer from the records office of the court where the infraction was handled - was a non-disclosure order under I.C. 34-28-5-15 already entered in your cause
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Answer from the records office of the court where the infraction was handled - was a non-disclosure order under I.C. 34-28-5-15 already entered in your cause
requiredBeforeFiling.why: whether the court already acted is a fact only that court's records hold
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the answer you are given when you ask the office of the clerk of the court where the infraction was handled whether an order under I.C. 34-28-5-15 was entered in your cause - write it down, because where the order exists there is nothing to file

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: How the matter ended, and on what date
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: How the matter ended, and on what date
requiredBeforeFiling.why: no disposition fact is held for a record the platform has not seen
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: how the infraction matter ended (never prosecuted, dismissed, found not to have committed it, adjudication vacated, deferral completed, or judgment satisfied) and the date it did - the earliest filing dates run from this
